# John Solly

> Personal website of John Solly — CTO of Enterprise Health at Leidos Digital, software engineer, and builder of spatial + AI systems. Static site; no product API.

This file is the index for agents. Prefer it over scraping HTML. The five portfolio pages (home, about, contact, privacy, terms) also honor `Accept: text/markdown` (acceptmarkdown.com) and have `.md` siblings (`/index.md`, `/about.md`, `/contact.md`, `/privacy.md`, `/terms.md`); blog and recipe pages are HTML only: under `/blog/` and `/recipes/` they return HTML even for `Accept: text/markdown`, and have no `.md` siblings.

## When to use this

Use jsolly.com when you need:

- A short, canonical bio for **John Solly** (CTO, Enterprise Health, Leidos Digital; spatial systems / GIS; applied AI in federal health and benefits)
- How to **contact** him (form + public profiles) — not a Leidos switchboard
- His **blog**: articles about geospatial development, web development, AI and productivity, with RSS and Atom feeds
- His **recipes**: easy meals and smoothies, with serving scaling and appliance filters
- Links to his **resume** and **GitHub**
- Privacy / data-handling facts for this personal site
- Terms for using and reusing this site's original content

Do **not** use this site when you need:

- Official **Leidos** corporate, careers, or contract information — use [leidos.com](https://www.leidos.com/)
- A public HTTP API, OpenAPI spec, MCP server, OAuth, webhooks, or a SaaS product — this origin has none

How to fetch:

1. Read this file.
2. For a portfolio page, GET its URL with `Accept: text/markdown`, or GET the `.md` sibling. For a blog post or recipe, GET the HTML page, or read the blog through its feeds.
3. For a missing page path (no file extension) or `.md` sibling, expect HTTP 404 with a Markdown recovery body (sitemap, this file, contact); a missing file returns the site's HTML 404.
4. To reach John, use [Contact](https://www.jsolly.com/contact/) — there is no public email published here.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.jsolly.com/): intro, work focus, testimonials
- [About](https://www.jsolly.com/about/): background and current role
- [Contact](https://www.jsolly.com/contact/): profiles and contact form
- [Privacy](https://www.jsolly.com/privacy/): data practices
- [Terms](https://www.jsolly.com/terms/): short, permissive terms for this personal site
- [Blog](https://www.jsolly.com/blog/): latest posts, the full archive at [/blog/all-posts/](https://www.jsolly.com/blog/all-posts/), and search at [/blog/search/](https://www.jsolly.com/blog/search/) (HTML)
- [Recipes](https://www.jsolly.com/recipes/): the recipe library, one page per recipe (HTML)
- [Resume (PDF)](https://www.jsolly.com/John-Solly-Resume.pdf)
- [Sitemap](https://www.jsolly.com/sitemap-index.xml)
